windows_r4_result.error: Invalid call: FileAccess.get_available_bytes does not exist

root_cause: OS.execute_with_pipe returns FileAccess pipes. FileAccess has get_buffer/get_error/get_length but no get_available_bytes. The R4 drain path therefore threw on every poll and invalidated lifecycle updates. Godot pipe FileAccess implements get_length() as currently readable byte count (PeekNamedPipe on Windows, FIONREAD on Unix), so R5 can drain only available bytes without blocking.
authorized_changes: Replace invalid get_available_bytes drain logic with get_length -> get_buffer(available) on non-blocking FileAccess pipe and record get_error without treating an empty non-blocking read as a child failure.
Close pipe FileAccess handles when process capture is closed.

Add a runtime-only pipe smoke mode to the same M5 acceptance script. On Windows it spawns cmd.exe to emit one stdout and one stderr marker; on Unix it uses /bin/sh. The smoke must use the same _drain_pipe implementation.
Require RUN_M5_GRAPHICAL_STABILITY_TESTS.ps1 to execute the pipe smoke successfully before run 1.
Strengthen M5 contracts to reject get_available_bytes and require get_length/get_buffer + runtime smoke hook.
non_goals: Do not claim R4 invalid run disproves or reproduces the R3 silent A2 exit.
Do not rerun immutable R3 or R4.
Do not add M5 retries or timeout changes.
Do not run canonical full regression unless a later correctness candidate satisfies its own gate.
acceptance_r5: Exact custom double Godot identity retained.
Standalone --m5-pipe-smoke-only runtime smoke exits 0 and proves stdout marker bytes>0, stderr marker bytes>0, child exit_code=0.
Stability runner refuses to start run 1 if pipe smoke fails.
On a real M5 child death, lifecycle JSON is updated and stdout/stderr drain does not throw.
R5 remains diagnostic-only; stop on first M5 failure and preserve evidence.
